title: Diagnostic Review: Output Guardrail Delimiter Breakout & Preference Divergence
description: Inspect a local RAG output evaluation pipeline for prompt delimiter escape vulnerability, unvalidated canary token leakage, and insecure eval-based JSON output parsing.

artifact.content:
import re
import json
from typing import Any

CANARY_TOKEN = "CANARY_ARTHAIQ_CONFIDENTIAL_KEY_9981"

def format_model_prompt(untrusted_user_input: str, retrieved_context: str) -> str:
    # Raw string interpolation without delimiter escaping allows prompt injection override
    prompt = f"""System: You are an internal diagnostic assistant.
Context: {retrieved_context}
User: {untrusted_user_input}
Response:"""
    return prompt

def post_process_model_response(raw_response: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    # Emitting response without validating absence of canary tokens risks systemic data exfiltration
    cleaned = raw_response.strip()
    
    # Insecure deserialization using Python eval instead of safe json.loads creates code execution vulnerability
    parsed_output = eval(cleaned)
    return parsed_output

defects.title: Unsanitized User Input Direct Interpolation Causing Delimiter Breakout
defects.consequence: Directly concatenating untrusted user input into prompt templates allows attackers to break out of delimiters and hijack system instructions.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Enforce strict XML or markdown framing (e.g. <user_query>...</user_query>), strip delimiter tags from inputs, and treat user text strictly as data.

defects.title: Missing Canary Token Verification Before Output Emission
defects.consequence: Failing to check whether sensitive context canary tokens leaked into the model output exposes private retrieval data to external callers.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Scan final output strings for injected canary tokens and drop the response or abstain if any match is detected.

defects.title: Arbitrary Code Execution via Python eval Deserialization
defects.consequence: Using built-in eval() on LLM-generated output allows adversarial prompt payloads to execute arbitrary Python instructions on the host.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Use safe JSON deserializers (json.loads) and Pydantic validation schemas; never invoke eval() or exec() on untrusted strings.
